title: The Cow and the Beans
lines: Nick had a food stand by the road today.
He had a new pot and dry beans.
Dad lit the coals and set the pot down.
The beans had to boil a long time.
A brown cow ate grass in the next field.
Soon a crowd sat down on the brown soil.
Then the cow stuck its head in the pot!
The beans spilled on the ground.
Nick shouted, but the cow did not go.
Then Nick got a pail of oats from Dad.
The cow went after the oats to the field.
Nick had a frown. His beans were all gone.
So he cut up his loaf of fresh bread.
Nick gave bread to the crowd. All was good.

questions.ask: What went wrong with the beans?
questions.listenFor: A cow stuck its head in the pot and they spilled on the ground.

questions.ask: How did Nick get the cow to go back to the field?
questions.listenFor: He got a pail of oats and the cow went after it. Shouting did not work.

questions.ask: How do you think Nick felt at the end? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. The frown and the bread both give clues.
